11/ BTC and other ETH killers
- value of ETH = volume ppl willing to pay on fees/on-chain activity
- other L1s good for other narrative reasons but not for SoV asset = 'fee maximalist'

5/ Even $DOGE can become SoV
- good volumes, memes, it's old and decentralized
- helps ETH by chipping at BTC maximalism that 21 mil cap has value etc but DOGE has no cap and outperforms BTC/kills narrative that alts cannot be up against sats
- very cheap, offers different niche
